Name: BFAV Squirrels
Author: vadie
TagLine:
Ever wanted to have some squirrels on your farm? Well, now you can!

This mod adds Eemie's squirrels as new farm animal entries along with a few new recolors. These squirrels tend to hunt out hazelnuts daily, and if really happy, they can even bri...
Description:
Make sure to have the updated BFAV 3.0 for Stardew Valley 1.4 installed before using the latest version. This updated BFAV means no more config editing, making things so much easier for BFAV animal installation~! Now you can just drag and drop the mod into your downloads folder after unpacking the zip file. Yay! ^__^

Updated BFAV 3.0 [can be found here!](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/156109690059751424/650047854831861778/Paritees_Better_Farm_Animal_Variety_3.0.6-unofficial.zip)Feel free to ask if you can't figure it out or there are errors. I would be glad to help!
Credit for the squirrel sprites goes to [Eemie](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1658)
Credit for the BFAV framework goes to [Paritee](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/60632686)

Downloads.Description: BFAV Squirrels that have custom nut products thanks to TrentXV~! To use these squirrels, you will need to download the Forageable Items file found here https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120 as that's where the custom products are.
